sources.location: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2022.839364/full; Wang et al., Frontiers in Nutrition 2022, DOI 10.3389/fnut.2022.839364
https://www.cellosaurus.org/CVCL_0025; Caco-2 entry, matched by sdrf-tools cellline lookup

claims.value: 15 RAW files in three five-run groups
claims.evidence: Exactly five Control_[1-5].raw, five BaP_[1-5].raw, and five Eriodictyol_BaP_[1-5].raw are categorized as associated RAW files; proteinGroups.txt is search output and excluded.

claims.value: DMSO vehicle, 50 uM BaP, or 20 uM eriodictyol plus 50 uM BaP for 24 h
claims.evidence: RAW prefixes identify the three proteomic groups. Paper Cell Culture and Treatments and Comparative Proteomic Analysis describe the exact doses and 24-hour co-treatment.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], comment[technical replicate]
claims.value: 15 distinct run-level sample IDs; replicate fields 1 within each source
claims.evidence: The deposit names five runs per treatment, but the paper does not map those runs to separate cultures or injections. Source names preserve each deposited run stem without asserting a replicate relationship across runs; replicate fields are 1 within each source.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[disease], characteristics[age], characteristics[sex]
claims.value: Homo sapiens; colon; Caco-2 CVCL_0025; colon adenocarcinoma; 72Y; male
claims.evidence: PRIDE specifies human and paper specifies a colon carcinoma Caco-2 line. Cellosaurus identifies Caco-2 as CVCL_0025 derived from colon of a 72-year-old male with colon adenocarcinoma. Disease describes the line's origin for every arm; Control is a DMSO exposure control, not a healthy-cell arm.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method]
claims.evidence: PRIDE instrument CV is Q Exactive HF MS:1002523. Paper and PRIDE protocol say top-10 data-dependent acquisition with HCD.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent]
claims.evidence: Paper Protein Digestion Methods specify 10 mM DTT reduction, 55 mM IAA alkylation, and 4 ug sequencing-grade trypsin overnight at 37 C.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters], comment[ms1 scan range]
claims.value: 6 ppm precursor, 20 ppm fragment, carbamidomethyl C fixed, oxidation M variable, 300-1800 m/z
claims.evidence: Paper Proteomics Analysis by LC-MS and PRIDE processing protocol state these search and survey-scan parameters; paper's phrase 'protein N-terminal oxidation of methionine' was normalized to oxidation M.

limitations: The five run suffixes per treatment may represent biological preparations or repeated injections; the paper does not explicitly resolve the five proteomic run identities. No cross-run biological or technical replicate relationship is asserted.
The PRIDE reconciler flags disease on control runs, but the control is DMSO-treated Caco-2, still derived from colon adenocarcinoma; the factor value records the treatment contrast.
The PRIDE reconciler flags trypsin because the project protocol omits the enzyme, while the linked paper explicitly specifies it in Protein Digestion Methods.
The exact model Q Exactive HF is from the PRIDE instrument CV; the paper gives only a broad mass-spectrometer description.
